announcements.title: StegZ 1.4 for Windows
announcements.message:
• Credits to Havenova X in Settings (click to visit)
• "Don't show this again" on announcements
• Text editor, archive previews and instant archive opening
Tip: press F1 for the Help guide.

announcements.title: StegZ 2.4 for Android
announcements.message:
• Installed apps: extract APKs (even split apps), open, uninstall
• APK info and install: package, version, permissions, signature
• Shred files and remove photo data (GPS, camera) for real privacy
• Search inside text and code files
Made by Havenova X
